title: Deliver advanced geospatial intelligence and rights-qualified property 3D
outcome: Acarat provides commute-aware search, large-scale market map layers, satellite/aerial context, panoramas, floor plans, and optional rights-qualified property digital twins with progressive web performance and explicit media provenance.
rationale: Program-level spatial/media child spanning roadmap P15-P16. It must be refined before implementation and does not admit restrictive research code.
scope_in: P15 advanced geospatial analytics and commute
acceptance: Spatial/media capabilities are decomposed into bounded Grains with provider rights, attribution, provenance, privacy, fidelity, performance, accessibility fallback, and commercial-license evidence.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; all heavy media pipelines remain replaceable derivatives.
